faq.q: Can you work during a live plant shutdown?
faq.a: Yes. A large share of our CFRP and lining work is delivered inside operator turnaround (TAM) windows — including overnight and emergency mobilisations.

faq.q: Do you work on pressurised process piping?
faq.a: We carry out in-service leak repair and CFRP reinforcement on pressurised lines, engineered to the defect and the service conditions.

faq.q: Which acids are your linings rated for?
faq.a: Our composite carbon fiber lining systems are rated for 98% sulfuric acid and 54% phosphoric acid concentrations.

faq.q: Do you only execute or also sell materials?
faq.a: Both. We supply CFRP fabric (unidirectional and multi-directional, 150–900 GSM) for maintenance teams that prefer in-house execution.

about.metaTitle: About — Seema General Contracting & Industrial Services
about.metaDesc: Founded in 2013, Seema is a Saudi specialist in the rehabilitation of concrete, steel structures and process pipes — partnering with international firms to bring engineered solutions to local industry.
about.title: A specialist contractor for what cannot fail.
about.lead: SEEMA General Contracting & Industrial Services Co. was established in 2013 with a specialised team of professionals and technicians engaged in the rehabilitation of concrete, steel structures and process pipes.
about.body1: We carry out repairs to concrete and steel structures and process pipes using epoxy materials, advanced carbon fiber and fiber-glass wrappings, concrete injections and industrial coating systems.
about.body2: We collaborate and partner with international and local companies in the field of civil engineering, structural maintenance and civil construction — transferring technology, training and technical support to the Kingdom's industrial sector.
about.teamSubtitle: Headquartered in Jubail, executing across the Kingdom.
about.hqDesc: Our headquarters in Jubail Industrial City coordinates our engineering, operations, and logistics across the Kingdom's industrial hubs.
about.teamDesc: Our specialized team of certified engineers, safety officers, and technicians undergo rigorous training to work on live, high-hazard industrial assets.

projects.subtitle: A snapshot of rehabilitation, CFRP lining and structural repair work delivered across the Kingdom's industrial sites.

featured.title: Compressor Foundation Rectification
featured.impact: Active plant operations secured, zero downtime during execution
featured.desc: Rectification of a large compressor foundation and high-performance fireproofing. Structural stabilization was successfully executed under active plant vibrations, restoring structural integrity.

featured.title: Transformer Foundations & Firewall
featured.impact: Thermal isolation and structural integrity fully restored
featured.desc: Rectification of two transformer foundations, fireproofing & firewall construction. Ensured structural protection and thermal shielding in extreme load utility environments.

featured.title: Acid Sewer Pit Rehabilitation
featured.desc: Rehabilitation of concrete drainage pit and acid sewer system with specialized chemical-resistant epoxy coatings, preventing soil contamination and structure degradation.

featured.title: Reactor CFRP Lining
featured.impact: Reactor lifecycle extended by 15+ years under 98% acid concentration
featured.desc: Emergency composite Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) lining on reactor PAP Train fume hood sleeve & roof during shutdown. Completed under tight deadline constraints.
